environment.description: Same binary deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS with a custom AppArmor profile loaded in enforce mode. The profile (named 'actix-config-svc') uses a deny-by-default posture with explicit path allowances. File read is restricted to '/var/app/config/** r' and '/usr/lib/** r' (shared libraries). Write access limited to '/var/app/config/user_uploaded.toml w'. The profile includes 'deny /proc/*/maps r,' and 'deny /etc/** r,' rules. Additionally, the profile specifies 'signal (receive) set=(segv) peer=unconfined -> deny,' which prevents the process from receiving SIGSEGV in a way that could be caught by a custom signal handler (though the default handler still terminates). The profile also sets 'deny ptrace,' preventing debugging attachment. The /tmp write for upload_config is allowed via '/tmp/uploaded_config.toml w'. Network confined to 'network inet stream,' only.
